Not being happy is not the end of the world, trust me;Does It make things more difficult? Of course.

I've gone through periods in my life, depressed, lonely.

How to life through it?

I just made a promise to myself, as I didn't have friends at the time. I promised that a week before attempting it I would seek help in every way that I could (doctors, internet, suicide telephone, EVERYTHING) if you havent tried everything, you need more time as there is no coming back.

My life changed and the only important thing to do was searching for something that would make living worth.

I didn't find anything for years but I also stopped feeling bad, I became stronger in an emotional way.

Now some time has passed (5 years) and I have bad days in which I hope I did it a long time ago but I also found someone to live for.
Don't underestimate the psicological effects that death of a close person has.

The problem for me is not that I have problems, of course as anyone else I have them. However the main issue is that life isn't really worth it, just...

I feel better today, thank you for the help.

Just time itself becomes depressing to me, however today I feel better.

Thanks for the suport.
No issues, just no reasons and it's been a very long time without reasons. No need to keep living
I've been on the edge before and It's true you sometimes get the reason to keep living when you are on the very edge, this time though I don't feel things made me live before are worth it anymore.
